answer: Farming becomes a dune bet on surviving 53 epochs of grading, and every ferrous settlement recomputes the lantern schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 53 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 7 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 16 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
